title: Can you fold paper more than 7 times with hydraulic press
summary: The Hydraulic Press Channel folds an A3 sheet of paper past the supposed seven-fold limit and then crushes it with a press. It is a short, quirky experiment.
why: Linked in paper folding threads as a fun demonstration and as the video that made the channel famous.

quote.text: It was this paper folding video (and the guy's unapologetic Finnish accent) that launched Hydraulic Press Channel to fame.
